description: Source code implementing a resource manager for OMX components, specifically managing video codec resources with functions for adding, removing, and waiting for resources, including mutex synchronization.

methods.name: addElementList
methods.description: Adds an OMX component to the resource list, allocating a new list node and linking it appropriately.

methods.name: removeElementList
methods.description: Removes an OMX component from the resource list, freeing the list node.

methods.name: searchLowPriority
methods.description: Searches for the lowest priority component in the list that has a higher group priority than the given priority.

methods.name: removeComponent
methods.description: Handles the removal of a component, including state transition and callback invocation.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ResourceManager_Init
methods.description: Initializes the resource manager, creating mutex.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ResourceManager_Deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the resource manager, freeing all list nodes and terminating mutex.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Get_Resource
methods.description: Allocates a resource for a component, managing the maximum number of video resources and replacing lower priority components if needed.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Release_Resource
methods.description: Releases a resource held by a component, potentially moving it to a waiting list and changing its state.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_In_WaitForResource
methods.description: Adds a component to the waiting list for resources.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Out_WaitForResource
methods.description: Removes a component from the waiting list for resources.
